vulnerability_behavior.specific_code_behavior_causing_vulnerabi: The function attempts to read more data than is actually present in the file, leading to repeated calls to ProfileInteger(image, hex_digits) without checking if the end of the file has been reached. This stops further processing and prevents the CPU from being consumed indefinitely.
